source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 8 exercise (PDF 120-121) solved, with the printed answer key (PDF 121) checked against the text.

blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur long sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
1. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is best described as:
(Artificial Intelligence (AI) ki behtareen tareef kya hai?)

options.text: Devices ko internet se jorne wala system
Insani jaise kaam karne wala program
Files online store karne ka tareeqa

blocks.explanation: AI (8.1) computer science ki shaakh hai jo machines ko woh kaam karne deti hai jin ke liye aam taur par insani zehanat chahiye. Devices jorna IoT hai aur online files rakhna cloud computing.

blocks.prompt:

(Internet of Things (IoT) zyada tar kis liye use hota hai?)

options.text: Devices ko khud-ba-khud aapas mein rabta karne dena

blocks.explanation: IoT (8.1) internet se jure physical devices ka network hai jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain; har device doosron se khud-ba-khud baat karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. An example of cloud computing is:
(Cloud computing ki misal kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Google Drive par document save karna internet ke remote servers par rakhna hai, yani cloud computing (8.1). Word apne computer par chalta hai, USB local storage hai aur smartwatch IoT device hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Blockchain technology is known for:
(Blockchain technology kis liye mashhoor hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain (8.1) records ko ek markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par rakhta hai; har block pichle se jura hota hai aur na badalne wali mehfooz chain banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. An ethical issue in AI systems is:
(AI systems ka ek akhlaqi (ethical) masla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI systems aise data se seekhte hain jis mein chhupa bias ho sakta hai (8.2); is se na-munsifana faisle hote hain, jaise hiring system ka mardon ko tarjeeh dena.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
1. What is Artificial Intelligence (AI) and how is it used in daily life?
AI kya hai aur rozmarra zindagi mein kaise use hoti hai?
blocks.explanation:
AI computer science ki shaakh hai jo machines ko insani zehanat wale kaam (seekhna, patterns pehchanna, faisla) karne deti hai.
Rozana istemal: voice assistants (Siri, Alexa), websites ke chatbots, chehra/tasweer pehchanna, YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon ki recommendations.

blocks.prompt:
2. How does the Internet of Things (IoT) connect smart devices together?
IoT smart devices ko aapas mein kaise jorta hai?
blocks.explanation: IoT devices mein sensors, processors aur communication hardware hota hai. Yeh Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular networks se jurte hain aur har device doosre devices ya markazi (cloud) platform se khud-ba-khud data ka tabadla karta hai, jis se actions chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. What are the main advantages of using Cloud Computing?
Cloud computing ke bare fawaid kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Scalability: zaroorat ke mutabiq storage aur computing power barhana ya ghatana.
2. Accessibility: data aur apps kabhi bhi, kahin se bhi, kai devices par.
3. Cost-effectiveness: mehnge servers aur maintenance staff ki zaroorat nahi; jitna use utni adaigi (pay-as-you-go).

blocks.prompt:
4. How does Blockchain ensure security and transparency in transactions?
Blockchain len-den mein hifazat aur transparency kaise yaqeeni banata hai?
blocks.explanation: Blockchain records ko ek markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par rakhta hai. Har tasdeeq shuda block pichle se jura hota hai aur na badalne wali chain banti hai; har computer ke paas copy hoti hai, is liye chupke se data badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai. Bank jaise darmiyani (intermediary) ke baghair sab record check kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:

6. What role do stakeholders play in the design and regulation of AI technologies?
AI technologies ke design aur qawaid mein stakeholders ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
- Developers AI banate aur use durust, munsifana aur akhlaqi rakhte hain.
- Users AI use karte aur reliability, privacy aur sahi nataij chahte hain.
- Governments mehfooz aur munsifana istemal ke liye policies aur qawaid banati hain.
- Communities samaji aur saqafati aqdar ki hifazat aur zimmedarana istemal ko farogh deti hain.

blocks.prompt:

Technology ke hal banate waqt saqafati shaoor kyun zaroori hai?

10. Why are laws and policies necessary for the responsible and safe use of technology?
Technology ke zimmedarana aur mehfooz istemal ke liye qawaneen aur policies kyun zaroori hain?

1. Explain how Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing, and Blockchain are transforming modern industries. Give suitable examples for each technology.
AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jadeed industries ko kaise badal rahi hain? Har ek ki misaal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Emerging technologies jadeed ijadaat hain jo logon ke rehne, kaam aur rabte ka tareeqa badal rahi hain. AI, IoT, Cloud aur Blockchain data, automation aur connectivity ke liye smart systems banati hain aur healthcare, taleem, transport aur zaraat ke kaam tez aur behtar karti hain.

1. Artificial Intelligence: machines ko insani zehanat wale kaam karne deti hai. Data se seekhti hai (machine learning) aur neural networks aur NLP (natural language processing: insani zaban samajhna) se awaaz samajhti, cheezein pehchanti aur andaza lagati hai.
Misalein: voice assistants (Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant), chatbots (Amazon, Daraz), chehron aur medical scans ki pehchan, YouTube recommendations, self-driving cars, DeepMind ka AI jo 3D eye scans se aankh ki bimari ka andaza lagata hai.

2. Internet of Things: sensors, processors aur communication hardware wale devices ka network jo Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular se data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain.
Misalein: smart ghar (lights, curtains, thermostat, security cameras), dil ki dharkan aur sugar napne wale sensors, irrigation ke liye zameen ki nami ke sensors.

3. Cloud Computing: data ko apne computer ke bajaye internet ke remote servers par rakhna aur process karna; kabhi bhi kahin se rasai, scalable aur sasta.
Misalein: files ke liye Google Drive aur iCloud, hosting, storage aur apps ke liye AWS aur Microsoft Azure, streaming aur online learning.

4. Blockchain: decentralized (bina markaz) system jo records ke jure blocks bohat se computers par rakhta hai; na badalne wali chain se shaffafiyat, hifazat aur bharosa.
Misalein: Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrency, supply chain tracking, zameen ke record, medical files aur taleemi certificates.

Yeh sab industries ko smart banati hain, magar data security, akhlaqiyat aur automation par inhisar jaise masail bhi lati hain jinhein zimmedari se sambhalna zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Discuss the benefits and challenges of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in society. How can ethical principles ensure fair and responsible use of AI?
Muashre mein AI ke fawaid aur challenges bataiye. Akhlaqi usool AI ka munsifana aur zimmedarana istemal kaise yaqeeni banate hain?
blocks.explanation:
AI kaam ko tez, durust aur aasan banati hai, magar is ke khatre bhi hain jinhein sambhalna zaroori hai.

Munsifana aur zimmedarana AI ke akhlaqi usool:
- Fairness (insaf): imtiyazi sulook na ho; admission system gender, ilaqe, zaban ya pas-manzar par student ko tarjeeh ya radd na kare.
- Accountability (jawabdehi): ghalat faisle ka koi zimmedar ho.
- Transparency (shaffafiyat): batana ke system ne faisla kaise kiya, jaise student kyun select ya reject hua.
- Safety (hifazat): diagnosis system achhi tarah test ho taake nuqsan-deh nateeja na de.
- Bias se bachao aur inclusivity: developers training data (jaise zyada mardon wala hiring data, ek rang ke chehron wala data) check aur durust karein taake AI sab ki barabar khidmat kare.
- Privacy aur qanooni frameworks: ijazat se data aur GDPR aur AI ethics guidelines jaise qawaid.
Yeh usool AI ko insani faide ka aala rakhte aur ghair-irada nuqsan se bachate hain.

rows: Dohrane wale kaam insanon se tez
Doctors ki tashkhees mein madad (3D scans se aankh ki bimari)
Zaati data ki privacy ka khatra
Algorithm ka bias na-munsifana nataij deta hai
Chatbots hazaron customers ko ek saath jawab; business trends ka andaza
Zindagi par asar wale faislon mein akhlaqi masail
Taleem mein har student ke mutabiq parhai
Automation par had se zyada inhisar

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bias ki misal: agar hiring AI sirf purane record se seekhe jahan zyada mard select hue, to woh aurat ke achhe CV ko bhi kam number dega. Is liye data check karna (bias hatana), faisle ki wajah batana (transparency) aur ghalti ka zimmedar tay karna (accountability) zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Describe how IoT devices collect and communicate data for automation. How is IoT improving sectors such as healthcare, agriculture, and smart homes?
IoT devices automation ke liye data kaise jama aur aage bhejte hain? IoT healthcare, zaraat aur smart gharon ko kaise behtar kar raha hai?
blocks.explanation:
IoT internet se jure physical devices ka network hai jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain. Devices mein sensors, processors aur communication hardware hota hai.

IoT kaise kaam karta hai (teen kaam):
1. Data collection: sensors mahol se data lete hain, jaise temperature, harkat, roshni ya nami.
2. Communication: devices Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular se data doosre devices ya cloud servers ko bhejte hain jahan process aur analyse hota hai; is se systems ek doosre se hum-ahang (synchronized) rehte hain.
3. Automation: analyse kiya data khud action chalata hai, jaise khali kamre ki lights band karna ya zameen sookhne par irrigation shuru. Haath se control kam, waqt bachta, insani ghalti kam.

Shobon mein behtari:
- Healthcare: sensors dil ki dharkan, blood pressure aur sugar ko foran napte hain; doctor door se mareez dekhte aur emergency mein jaldi amal karte hain.
- Zaraat: devices zameen ki nami, temperature aur mausam napte hain; irrigation aur fasal ka behtar intezam, paidawar zyada aur zaya kam.
- Smart ghar: lights, heating, curtains aur security mobile app ya awaaz se; smart LED bulb shaam 6 baje jalta hai, curtains subah alarm ke saath khulte aur 35°C se upar band hote hain, thermostat pasand ke mutabiq, cameras phone par alert bhejte hain. Aaraam, bijli ki bachat aur hifazat.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: IoT ka chakkar yaad rakhein: sensor (mehsoos karna) -> controller/cloud (sochna) -> actuator (amal karna). Misal: soil sensor ne nami kam napi -> cloud ne faisla kiya "pani chahiye" -> pump khud chal gaya. Insaan ko sirf phone par message aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Explain how Cloud Computing supports scalability, accessibility, and collaboration. Compare different cloud platforms like Google Drive, AWS, and Microsoft Azure.
Cloud computing scalability, accessibility aur collaboration mein kaise madad deti hai? Google Drive, AWS aur Microsoft Azure ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cloud computing mein data apne computer ke bajaye internet ke remote servers par rakha, manage aur process kiya jata hai, jo cloud service providers chalate hain.

- Scalability: zaroorat ke mutabiq storage aur computing power aasani se barhana ya ghatana; barhte karobar ke liye behtareen.
- Accessibility: data aur apps kabhi bhi, kahin se bhi aur kai devices se, files haath se muntaqil kiye baghair.
- Collaboration (mil kar kaam): files aur tools online hain, is liye mukhtalif jagahon ke log ek hi data par kaam kar sakte hain; collaborative workspaces, online learning aur streaming.
- Cost-effectiveness: mehnge servers aur staff ki zaroorat nahi; pay-as-you-go.

Platforms ka muqabla (table): Google Drive aam logon ke liye tayyar service hai, jabke AWS aur Azure bare platforms hain jin par karobar aur developers apne systems banate hain. (Kitab Google Drive ko sirf cloud mein document save karne ki misal kehti hai; tafseeli muqabla chapter se bahar hai.)

rows: Zaati aur school files save aur share karna
Web hosting, data storage, apps banana
Cloud par applications banana aur chalana
Cloud services aur computing ki wasee range (IaaS/PaaS)
Teams hosted apps aur data share karti hain
Teams shared apps banati aur chalati hain

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asaan misal: Google Drive kiraye ki tayyar almari hai jis mein aap apni files rakhte hain. AWS aur Azure kiraye ki poori factory hain jahan company apni website ya app khud bana kar chalati hai, aur zaroorat barhne par factory bari kar sakti hai (scalability).

blocks.prompt:
5. What is Blockchain technology? Discuss how its decentralized nature improves transparency and security in financial and non-financial applications.
Blockchain technology kya hai? Is ki decentralized banawat maali aur ghair-maali kaamon mein transparency aur hifazat kaise barhati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Blockchain ek digital system hai jo maloomat ko ek markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par mehfooz tareeqe se rakhta aur share karta hai. Har tasdeeq shuda record (block) pichle se jura hota hai aur na badalne wali chain banti hai.

Decentralization (markaz na hona) ka faida:
- Har computer ke paas chain ki copy, is liye chupke se data badalna taqreeban na-mumkin (hifazat).
- Sab hissedar ek hi record dekh aur check kar sakte hain (shaffafiyat).
- Bank ya hukumat jaise darmiyani hat jaate hain; seedha, durust aur jawabdeh len-den (bharosa).
- Ek block badlo to agle se rishta toot jata hai, is liye cheri-chaar pakri jaati hai.

Maali (financial) istemal:
- Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrency: bank ke baghair mehfooz peer-to-peer len-den.

Ghair-maali istemal:
- Supply chain: maal ko shuru se customer tak track karna aur asli hona yaqeeni banana; zaraat mein paidawar aur taqseem ke har marhale ka record, dhoka kam aur munsifana tijarat.
- Data security: qanooni kaghzat, medical files aur certificates ka mehfooz record.
- Hukumat aur taleem: zameen ke record aur taleemi asnaad.

Majmui taur par blockchain digital systems ko bharosemand, shaffaf aur behtar banata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Blockchain ko aise samjhein: ek khata (register) jis ki copy poori class ke paas hai. Agar koi ek student apni copy mein raqam badal de to baqi sab ki copies se mel nahi khayegi aur ghalti foran pakri jayegi. Har naya safha pichle safhe ke "nishan" (hash) se jura hota hai, is liye purana safha chupke se badla nahi ja sakta.

blocks.prompt:
6. Identify key national challenges in Pakistan and describe how emerging technologies (AI, IoT, Cloud, Blockchain) can provide effective and innovative solutions.
Pakistan ke aham qaumi masail pehchaniye aur bataiye ke emerging technologies (AI, IoT, Cloud, Blockchain) un ke kya moassar aur naye hal de sakti hain.
blocks.explanation:
Qaumi masail pehchanna ba-maani hal ki taraf pehla qadam hai.

Pakistan ke aham masail:
- Healthcare: mehdood rasai aur wasail ki kami.
- Taleem: quality aur door daraz tak pohanch mein rukawatein.
- Zaraat: kam karkardagi, kam paidawar aur pani ki kami.
- Governance: shaffafiyat aur karkardagi ki zaroorat.
- Deegar: traffic control aur pani ka intezam.

Emerging technologies se hal:
- AI: medical data se jaldi tashkhees; students ke liye intelligent tutoring; mausam ka andaza laga kar fasal ki hifazat.
- IoT: zaraat mein mahol aur zameen ki nigrani; smart city aur traffic control.
- Cloud: taleemi mawad ko store aur taqseem karna; kisanon, researchers aur policymakers ko mehfooz data.
- Blockchain: governance mein shaffafiyat; records ki tasdeeq; zarai supply chain shaffaf aur dhoka kam.

Milap ki misal (smart agriculture): IoT sensors nami napte hain, AI pani ki zaroorat aur mausam ka andaza lagata hai, Cloud data rakhta aur analyse karta hai, Blockchain supply chain ka record rakhta hai. Pani aur kharcha bachta, paidawar barhti hai.

Aisi applications asal masle se shuru hoti hain, design thinking se user ke mutabiq banti hain aur Pakistan ki saqafat, zabanon aur aqdar ka ehtram karti hain taake sab ke liye aur qabil-e-bharosa hon.

blocks.prompt:
7. Discuss the ethical and cultural considerations involved in designing AI systems. How can developers ensure inclusivity and respect for local values?
AI systems ke design mein akhlaqi aur saqafati pehlu bataiye. Developers shamooliyat (inclusivity) aur maqami aqdar ka ehtram kaise yaqeeni banayein?
blocks.explanation:
AI systems sirf technical cheez nahi, samaji aale bhi hain jo afraad, communities aur hukumaton par asar dalte hain; is liye in ke akhlaqi aur saqafati asraat dekhna zaroori hai.

Akhlaqi pehlu:
- Insaf: gender, ilaqe, zaban ya pas-manzar par imtiyaz nahi.
- Jawabdehi: ghalat faisle ka zimmedar maujood ho.
- Shaffafiyat: system ke faisle ki wajah batayi ja sake.
- Hifazat: system test ho taake nuqsan na de.
- Privacy aur ijazat: data wazeh ijazat se; data ka ghalat istemal bharosa torta hai.
- Stakeholders mein tawazun: karobar munafe ke liye data chahte hain, users privacy, hukumat taraqqi aur huqooq mein tawazun.

Saqafati pehlu:
- Saqafati aqdar privacy, baat cheet aur technology apnane ki tawaqqoat banati hain; kuch muashre aasani se data dete hain, kuch raazdari chahte hain.
- Language models mein mukhtalif zabanein aur lehje hon taake ghalib saqafat ki taraf bias na ho.
- AI ke faisle aur mawad maqami riwaj aur samaji usoolon ka ehtram karein.

Developers kya karein:
- Training data check aur durust karein taake har group (gender, umar, rang, ilaqa) shamil ho.
- Maqami zabanein (Urdu aur ilaqai zabanein) aur munasib mawad.
- Mukhtalif users ke saath test aur communities se mashwara.
- Shaffaf data policy aur aasan ijazat (consent).
- Sociologists, ethicists aur qanooni mahireen ke saath kaam.
- Qaumi AI policies aur bain-ul-aqwami guidelines ki pairwi.

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe the importance of policies, regulations, and interdisciplinary collaboration in promoting responsible innovation. How can Pakistan benefit from adopting global AI governance standards?
Zimmedarana ijaad (responsible innovation) mein policies, qawaid aur mukhtalif shobon ke ishtirak ki ahmiyat bataiye. Pakistan duniya ke AI governance miyar apna kar kya faida utha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Responsible innovation ka matlab technology ko sirf maali faide ke bajaye insani bhalai ke liye banana hai: zindagi behtar, naye mauqe, kam se kam nuqsan aur lambe arse ke samaji aur mahoolyati asraat ka khayal.

Policies aur qawaid ki ahmiyat:
- Emerging technologies privacy, rozgar, faislon aur hifazat par asar dalti hain; qanoon ke baghair ghalat istemal ya na-insafi ho sakti hai.
- Policies batati hain ke data kaise jama, store aur use ho; hifazat aur logon ke huqooq.
- Taraqqi aur jawabdehi mein tawazun aur awami bharosa.

Mukhtalif shobon ke ishtirak (interdisciplinary collaboration) ki ahmiyat:
- Qanooni mahireen qawaid ki pabandi yaqeeni banate hain.
- Sociologists (samajiyat ke mahireen) technology ka samaji asar dekhte hain.
- Ethicists akhlaqi faislon ki rehnumai karte hain.
- Developers ke saath mil kar mutawazin aur sab ke liye hal; zaban, saqafat aur rasai ka khayal taake system har kisi ke liye chale.

Aalmi miyar: GDPR (European Union) data ki hifazat, privacy aur users ke huqooq ke sakht qawaid deta hai; bain-ul-aqwami AI ethics guidelines jawabdehi, insaf, shaffafiyat aur insani izzat par zor deti hain.

Pakistan ko faida:
- Taraqqi akhlaqi miyar ke mutabiq aur shehriyon ke mafaad mehfooz.
- Shehriyon ke data aur privacy ki mazboot hifazat.
- Tehqeeq aur maqami zaroorat ke mutabiq AI hal ko farogh.
- AI par awami bharosa.
- Aalmi shirakat aur sarmaya-kari, kyunke bairooni companies tasleem shuda miyar wale mulk par bharosa karti hain.
- AI qaumi taraqqi mein musbat hissa dalti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Seedhi baat: qanoon (policy) batata hai "kya karna hai aur kya nahi", mukhtalif mahireen mil kar dekhte hain ke technology kisi group ke saath na-insafi to nahi kar rahi, aur aalmi miyar apnane se doosre mulk Pakistan ke systems par bharosa karte hain, jis se kaam aur sarmaya aata hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab chapter ke text se: 1b 2a 3a 4a 5a 6b 7a 8a 9b 10b. Kitab ki answer key (PDF 121) tamam 10 jawabon mein text se milti hai.
Long 2 (fawaid aur challenges) aur Long 4 (Google Drive, AWS, Azure) ke jawab table mein hain; Google Drive, AWS aur Azure ka tafseeli muqabla chapter se thora bahar hai.
Short aur long sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
